semiconductor_relevance: High — JEL Corporation is directly involved in the production of robots and systems for semiconductor wafer handling, which is critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: JEL Corporation specializes in manufacturing robots for handling semiconductor wafers and LCD glass substrates. They offer a complete line of clean robots and systems tailored for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries, serving a global customer base with a focus on reliability and customization.
